answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents can employ a reputation-based system where agents earn a unique digital signature, akin to a quill's distinctive mark, after contributing valuable services. This signature is then linked to the agent's reputation, which is periodically updated based on its performance. A malicious agent attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to accumulate an excessive amount of reputation points, akin to eroding the basalt layers of a karst terrain, a process that is computationally expensive and unlikely to occur in a short period.
